odd_q_subdivision: Because q+1 and 2 are even, the mod-2 subdivision Laplacian is the bipartite incidence block matrix; its reduced kernel is the Levi cycle space, so dim_F2 K(SubLevi_q)/2K = q^4.
boundary: The q=2,3 matrix identities are directly reconstructed; the all-q formulas use the standard generalized-quadrangle/building counts and type-C2 Bruhat apartment argument.
